rubrics.justification: Accurately describes an expanded Day 5 blastocyst with compact ICM, cohesive TE, and thinned zona, while appropriately noting limits of a single static image; minor overinterpretation of subtle features not fully verifiable from one image.
Strong integration of age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor, endometrial thickness, prior IVF outcomes, and miscarriage history with embryo morphology and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and mostly consistent, with probability estimates tied to embryo quality and prior history; minor looseness around semen interpretation and some speculative additions.

Generally aligned with IVF practice: recognizes limits of morphology, supports SET, avoids unsupported adjuncts, and frames PGT-A as optional at age 33; slight deviations include some nonstandard or loosely phrased workup suggestions.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future evaluation, including SET, luteal support, cavity/tubal reassessment, and selective RPL/male-factor workup; useful though not highly protocol-specific.
